messages:
matt_g: Heads-up: launching a "short-rotation swap" policy for small Dedicated pools (<=6 GPUs) as a limited preview next week. Aimed at smoothing spikes in eu-west1 and us-central.

matt_g: Key idea: for tiny pools we can do brief, automated swaps to nearby spare capacity to avoid long queue tails. Swaps will be short (target <=20m) and visible in audit logs. No change to reserved billing.

sarah_p: Customer impact summary: if you're in the preview cohort we'll notify you 24h before your pool is eligible. You can opt-out for workloads that require strict locality.

lina_ops: Ops note: replacement order = same-zone preferred -> same-region alt -> cross-region last resort. We'll bias replacements to equal-or-better GPU class.

devin_sre: CLI/API examples for teams:
```
# show swap policy on a pool
rwctl dedicated pools get --id small-123 --fields swap_policy

# subscribe to pool events
rwctl events subscribe --pool-id small-123 --types swap.scheduled,swap.completed
```

devin_sre: Console will show an upcoming swap banner on the pool detail page and emit `swap.scheduled` with expected duration. SDKs return `swap_hint` in routing metadata.

capacity-bot: automated: policy "short-rotation-swap-v1" created by matt_g at 2026-04-20T15:12Z. Preview rollout window: 2026-04-27 -> 2026-05-11. Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/short-rotation-swap

legal_james: Note for contracts team: reserved terms unchanged; adding customer-facing FAQ and an opt-out mechanism suffices for preview. Please loop in sales for any contract edge-cases.

ops_bot: Monitor alert: expect temporary spike in routing churn metrics during first 24h. Threshold: >12% repeated swaps in a region triggers auto-hold.

sarah_p: Billing: no extra charges. If a swap forces use of a higher-cost GPU for >30m we will issue pro-rated credits automatically; see billing section in doc.

matt_g: For customers requesting exemptions: open support ticket tagged `swap-exempt` with justification + perf SLOs. Enterprise accounts with pinned region/zone are exempt by default unless they opt into preview.

lina_ops: Oncall runbook snippet:
- verify `swap.scheduled` in audit log
- check replacement GPU family and ETA
- if replacement is cross-region or ETA >25m escalate to devin_sre
- file incident if client reports degraded correctness (rare)

devin_sre: Metrics we'll watch: tail wait time, swap frequency, per-pool latency delta, and cross-family fallback rate. Expect to publish a short readout after two weeks.

matt_g: Owners & next steps:
- eng-platform (devin): API + event fields (priority)
- ops (lina): runbooks + monitoring dashboards
- comms (sarah): customer notices + FAQ
- legal (james): review FAQ copy

sarah_p: We'll run the preview in two waves: 10% of small pools in eu-west1 then 10% in us-central. Opt-out window available during enrollment.

matt_g: Thanks all. Ping me here if you want your team's pools included in the initial 10%.
thread_short_summary: Preview: 'short-rotation swap' policy for small Dedicated GPU pools (<=6 GPUs). Details on replacement order, CLI/API hooks, billing credits, opt-out/exemption process, runbook actions, monitoring, and rollout waves provided.
